purpose: Execute the published CTTS key-recovery engine, rather than another implementation, on unknown-key letter and homophonic controls.
prior_exposure: Source inspected, compilation completed, references normalized and controls generated; no optimization run before freeze
Pliny and Paradiso have been exposed in older project phases; they are separate from the CTTS reference corpora, not blind to the analyst

core.seeded_instrumentation: Four Random constructions share a seeded java.util.Random; finite restarts; best-key capture including initial states; score-call counter. No score/acceptance/move change.
core.wrapper: Invokes private SA synchronously after reproducing solve's sorting, capacities, indices and statistics; retains original reference normalization.

cases.selection: Four nonoverlapping quarters of each normalized target, start +100, fit then gap250 then transfer1000
cases.generation: Homophone counts match CTTS capacity vector derived from reference frequencies; random symbols and per-occurrence homophone draws; key only in truth file
cases.normalization: Inherited phase10 target words, then CTTS language substitutions and duplicate removal within words. All spaces removed; no OTHER boundary tokens.
cases.overlap: Abort if any target fit/transfer 80-character substring occurs in normalized reference. Shorter similarities not excluded.

evaluation.selection: Highest CTTS score on fit alone; freeze all eight outputs before reading truth for accuracy.
metrics: Recovered mapping on observed symbol types
All errors, candidate and true-key reference score
evaluation.gate: Each of eight cases must achieve >=0.95 fit and >=0.95 transfer character accuracy. No tuning or extra restarts based on accuracy.
limits: Language and homophone capacity family provided
No word segmentation or meaning validated
Eight samples from two target works and two reference works; dependent conditions
No claim that EVA units are letters or that all substitution families are excluded

next_step: If any calibration case fails, preserve results and diagnose score versus search without a Voynich reading. If all pass, define and freeze a separate manuscript/control comparison before running it. Passing is a prerequisite, not a decipherment.
